omitted: Embedding models (Mistral Embed, Codestral Embed) are excluded: the schema's PricingPeriod requires an output rate and these are input-only embedding endpoints.
OCR (per-1,000-pages) and Voxtral audio models (per-1,000-characters for TTS, per-minute for transcription) are excluded: priced in units this per-million-tokens schema does not model.

Only models with an explicit per-million-tokens input/output price on https://mistral.ai/pricing/api as fetched are included; the top-level https://mistral.ai/pricing overview page and https://mistral.ai/products/la-plateforme page do not render a usable table via automated fetch and were not used as the source of record.
Mistral Embed ($0.1/M) and Codestral Embed ($0.15/M) are embedding models: input-only pricing with no output rate, which this schema's required input+output shape does not represent.

As of 2026-09-07 the Devstral, Magistral, Mistral NeMo and Mixtral entries in this file were not surfaced by the page fetch - see their per-period notes; they are kept at their 2026-08-05 observation rather than deleted.
